note: Starting vault for Northbeam, a fictional product and design studio used to show off the studio look. Every item is invented: no real company, person, place, event or figure. The numbers are round and illustrative only. Imported once on an empty database; edit or delete in the app afterwards.

vault.title: Products shipped
vault.body: Northbeam has shipped 140 products with its clients since the studio opened (illustrative figure).

vault.title: The product teams report
vault.body: 1,200 teams answered the studio's questions on planning, testing and shipping in 2026 (illustrative figure).

vault.title: How the studio works
vault.body: Northbeam brings four things to a team: customer research, product design, engineering and training.

vault.title: Product sprint
vault.body: A six-week sprint for early teams: from a question to a tested prototype, with three people from the studio.

vault.title: Larkford Make
vault.body: The studio runs a workshop on designing forms people finish at Larkford Make, an invented design event in the invented town of Larkford.

vault.title: Studio fellowship
vault.body: The Northbeam studio fellowship for 2027 is taking entries: ten weeks inside the studio on live client projects, with a mentor (invented programme).

vault.title: Open role (internal)
vault.body: An example of an internal note: the salary band for the backend developer role. The tag not-for-posts tells reviewers to keep it out of posts.

topics: product strategy and design for early-stage software teams
